title: Electronic Arts: FIFA, The Sims, Madden and More - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 106]

reader_summary.headline: This is Matt Reustle and today we are breaking down the iconic video game publisher, Electronic Arts.
reader_summary.overview: This is Matt Reustle and today we are breaking down the iconic video game publisher, Electronic Arts. EA’s corporate history dates back to the 1980s and the business has evolved with all of the industry shifts in the decades since. To break down EA, I am joined by the author of The10thMan blog.

key_points.text: We cover the role of a publisher in the video game ecosystem, the history and dynamics behind crown jewels like FIFA and Madden.
